tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: 1. Penalty confirmed of ₹ 1,79,81,586/- under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 on account of availment of Input Tax Credit of Compensation Cess for the period FY 2018–19 to FY 2023–24. 2. Penalty confirmed of ₹ 75,17,512/- under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 on account of availment of Input Tax Credit of Compensation Cess for the period FY 2024–25. 3. Demand of Input Tax confirmed amounting to ₹ 37,48,073/- in IGST under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017, on account of excess availment of ITC in GSTR-3B as compared to ITC reflected in GSTR-2A, along with interest under Section 50 of the Act and penalty equivalent to the tax amount under Section 122(2)(b) of the CGST Act, for the period from FY 2018–19 to FY 2023–24. 4. Demand of ITC confirmed of ₹3,86,540/-in IGST & SGST each under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017, on account of excess availment of CGST and SGST in GSTR-3B as compared to credit reflected in GSTR-2A for the period FY 2024–25, along with interest under Section 50 of the Act and penalty equivalent to the tax amount under Section 122(2)(b) of the CGST Act, 2017.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Palghar Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed an appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals) against the aforesaid order. The said order has no impact on the Company’s financial operations or any other business activities.

entities.name: Bhageria Rare Earth Minerals Private Limited

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Dyes And Pigments

operating_notes.text: Raw material costs surged 76% YoY to ₹540.6 Cr in FY26.
Chemicals segment contributed 95% of total revenue in FY26.
Bhageria Rare Earth Minerals Private Limited incorporated as a 100% subsidiary with ₹1 lakh authorised capital, to hold investments in other entities; yet to commence business.
7 MW solar PV plant commissioned by subsidiary Rahuri Cleantech at Khanapur, Maharashtra, split 3.5 MW each on Bay-I and Bay-II; part of 32 MW under MSKVY 2.0.

timeline.summary: 2026-05-14: Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Bhageria Rare Earth Minerals Private Limited with ₹1 lakh authorised capital, yet to commence business.
On 16th May 2026, Bhageria Industries reported that SAT adjourned the appeal against the SEBI adjudication order to July 2026, extending the stay.
2026-05-25: Wholly owned subsidiary Rahuri Cleantech commissioned a 7 MW solar PV plant at Khanapur, Maharashtra, part of a 32 MW MSKVY 2.0 programme.
